raw_or_corrupt_serialized_state_model.reachability: An arbitrary malformed serialized token is not guaranteed to reach CR14a. If decode/schema rejects it, that earlier error has precedence and boundary_link_mismatch is unreachable for that mutation. A raw corruption reaches boundary_link_mismatch exactly when it survives all earlier admission/normalization as a value z with z != b.
raw_or_corrupt_serialized_state_model.nonredundancy: CR14a is nonredundant relative to earlier parser/schema checks iff at least one parser/schema-valid, pre-verifier-preserved z != b exists. Out-of-domain malformed tokens alone cannot establish CR14a nonredundancy because they are intercepted earlier.
raw_or_corrupt_serialized_state_model.classification: boundary_link_mismatch is an admitted-link-integrity detector, not a universal raw-corruption detector

post_schema_admissible_state_model.reachability: Because admission has already occurred, CR14a is reachable iff A contains some z != b and no earlier normalization re-closes last_row_identity to b.

bounded_leaf_result.precedence_result: The two fault models differ only before CR14a: raw/corrupt faults are filtered by decode/schema and normalization, while post-schema admissible faults start after that filter. CR14a remains nonredundant exactly when such an admitted-but-wrong value can survive to the check.
